paite: Huan David bel Ramah a Naioth a pan atai a, Jonathan kiang ava tung hi. "Bang ka hih a ahia? Bang ahia ka tatsiatna? Na pa tung ah bang ahia ka hihkhelh, hichitak a hon thah atup maizen?" achi hi.
heading: Jonathan In David Apanpih
english: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”

paite: Ama'n, "That lou e. Na si het kei ding. Ngai in, ka pa'n kei hon theisak lou in bangmah himhim lian in neu taleh, ahih ngei kei hi. Bang ding in ahia hiai thute kei ahon iim ding? Ahon iim kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”

paite: David in, "Na mitmuh in deihsakna ka tang chih na pa'n atheichian mahmah ngal a, alungsim in, hiai zaw Jonathan in thei dah hen, huchi lou in zaw alungkham lo kha ding, chi ahi ding. Himahleh TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, sihna toh ka kikal uh kal khat lel ahi," chi in uangtak in agen hi.
english: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Na hinna in adeih peuhpeuh ka hon hihsak zel ding," achi hi.
english: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”

paite: David in Jonathan kiang ah, "Ngai in, zingchiang a kha thak ding ahi. Kumpipa kiang a ankuang um ngeingei ding ka hi. Himahleh ani thum ni nitaklam tanpha in gamlak a kibu ding in ka kuan zaw ding.
english: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.

paite: Na pa'n ka om louh lam ahon theihkhiakleh, David in akhua Bethlehem a va hoh zual ding hon ngen ngutngut a; a-inkuan ua dia kum teng a akithoih hun uh ahi," na chi in.
english: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem, his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’

paite: "Ahoih vo oi, achihleh na sikha alungmuang ding. Himahleh ahehleh thil hoih lou hih atum, chih thei mai in.
english: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.

paite: Huaiziak in na sikha hoihtak in hih in. Na sikha lah TOUPA thukhun ah na lutpihta ngal a. Himahleh tatsiatna nei ka hihleh nangmah in hon that mai in. Bangziak a na pa kiang a hon pi chitchiat ding na hia?" achi hi.
english: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”

paite: Jonathan in, "That lou e. Ka pa'n na tung a thil hoih lou hih atum chih ka theih peuhmah leh nang hilh lou in ka om mahmah dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”

paite: Huchi in David in Jonathan kiang ah, "Na pa'n hehngoh in hon na dawng taleh kua'n ahon hilh dia?" achi hi.
english: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Pai dih, gamlak ah i va hoh peuhmah ding," achi hi. Huchi in gamlak ah ava hohkhawm uhi.
english: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "TOUPA Israelte' Pathian atheihpihtu hi hen. Zingchiang hichih hun hiam, ani thum ni hiam a ka pa ka va dawp hun a, ngai in, David tungtang thu ahoih lam ahihleh na kiang a mi hon sawl in ka hong hilh kei dia hia?
english: Jonathan said to David, “By Yahweh, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?

paite: Ka pa'n na tung ah thil hoih lou hih ut bang hitaleh, ka hon hilh louh a, lungmuangtak a na paitheihna dia ka hon khah keileh, TOUPA'N Jonathan abawlbawl in bawl henla, huai sang a thupi in leng. Ka pa kiang a a-om zel bang in TOUPA na kiang ah om hen.
english: Yahweh do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May Yahweh be with you as he has been with my father.

paite: Ka sihlouhna dia ka damsung kia a TOUPA hehpihna hon musak hilou in,
english: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of Yahweh while I still live, that I not die;

paite: tangtawn in ka inkote leng na hehpih tawp ke'n. TOUPA'N David melma leitung a pan ahihman khit vek pha in leng tawp ke'n," achi hi.
english: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when Yahweh has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”

paite: Jonathan in David inkote toh thukhun bawl in, "David melmate khut tan in leng TOUPA'N phut hen," achi uhi.
english: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “Yahweh will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”

paite: Huchi in Jonathan in David akichiamsak nawn hi; amah hinna a-it bang geih in lah a-it ngal a.
english: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had for him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

paite: Huchi in Jonathan in akiang ah, "Zingchiang a kha thak ding ahi. Na tutna avuak ding ziak in na om louh akilang ngei ding hi.
english: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

paite: Ni thum na om nung in paisuk pah inla, tuma a thil ahong om lai a na kibukna mun ah hoh inla, Ezel suang chin ah ana om gige in.
english: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.

paite: Muitum bang in thaltang thum asik ah ka hon kapkhe ding hi.
english: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.

paite: Ngai in, kuan inla, thaltangte va mukhia in, chi in naupang ka sawl ding hi. Naupang kiang a, en in, thaltangte na nunglam ah a-om, la inla hong pai in, ka chihleh TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, nang a ding in agalmuanhuai in lauh ding om lou ahi ding.
english: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come, for there is peace to you and no danger, as Yahweh lives.

paite: Himahleh naupang kiang a, en in, thaltangte na pamlam ah a-om uh, ka chihleh paimang mai in. TOUPA'N ahon paimangsak ahi ding.
english: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for Yahweh has sent you away.

paite: Nang leh ke'n thil i gensa tungthu ah ngai in, nang toh i kikal ah TOUPA a-om tawntung hi,” achi hi.
english: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, Yahweh is between you and me forever.”

paite: Huchi in David gamlak ah akibu a; kha ahong thak a, kumpipa ankuang um in atu hi.
english: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.

paite: Hun dang a atutna ngei bang in atutna ah kumpipa atu hi. Jonathan adingh a, Saul kiang ah Abner atu a; David mun bel avuak hi.
english: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.

paite: Himahleh Saul in huai ni in bangmah agen kei, "Atung ah thil banghiam a-om a, siang lou hiam ahi ding, siang lou ahi ngei ding," achi hi.
english: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khadet zing ani nih ni in David mun avuak lailai hi. Huchi in Saul in atapa Jonathan kiang ah, "Bang achia Jesse tapa zan leh tuni a ankuang um dia hong pai lou ahia?" achi hi.
english: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”

paite: Jonathan in Saul adawng a, "David in Bethlehem a hoh ding ahon ngen ngutngut hi.
english: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.

paite: Hon hohsak teitei in, ka inkote'n khua ah kithoihna nei ding in ahon thukhak tinten uh. Huchi in na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh hon hohsak inla, ka unaute ka va veh ding, achi hi. Huaiziak in kumpipa dohkan ah ahong kei hi," achi hi.
english: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”

paite: Huchi in Jonathan tung ah Saul aheh guih a, akiang ah, "Nang, numei genhak leh helhat tapa, Jesse tapa na zahlakna ding leh na nu vuaktanna zahlaksak ding in na tel chih thei lou hon sa na hi hiam?
english: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?

paite: Jesse tapa hiai a a-om sung teng hihkip na hi kei dia, na gam leng. Huaiziak in samsak pah inla, ka kiang ah hon pisak in, asih ngeingei ding ahi," achi hi.
english: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”

paite: Jonathan in apa Saul adawng a, akiang ah, "Bang ding in maw thah ding ahih? Bang ahih a ahia?" achi hi.
english: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”

paite: Saul in thah tum in teipi in akhoh a, huchi in Jonathan in apa'n David thah atum ngei, chih achian hi.
english: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

paite: Jonathan bel dohkan a pan heh mahmah kawm in adingh a, huai kha ani nih ni in an a-um kei hi. Apa'n David azahlaksak mahmah ziak in alungkhampih hi.
english: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, zingsang in Jonathan in naupang khat pi in gamlak ah David toh amun sehsa uah ahoh uhi.
english: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.

paite: Anaupang kiang ah, "Tai inla, ka thaltang kapkhiakte va zong in," achi hi. Naupang atai lai in, apam lam ah thaltang akap hi.
english: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

paite: Jonathan in akapkiakna mun a naupang ava tun in Jonathan in naupang asam a, "Thaltang na pamlam ah ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”

paite: Jonathan in anaupang asam a, "Hong pai meng in, kin in, zekai ke'n,” achi hi. Jonathan naupang in thaltangte atawmkhawm a, apu kiang ah ahong paita hi.
english: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

paite: Himahleh, naupang in bangmah athei kei, Jonathan leh David kia in thil omdan athei uhi.
english: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

paite: Jonathan in anaupang kiang ah athal leh avante apia a, akiang ah, "Pai inla, khua ah ana paipih in," achi hi.
english: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”

paite: Jonathan in apaitak in David omna mun simlam pang a pan adingh a, amai a lei si in thumvei akunsuk a, akitawptuah ua, akikahkhum ua, David anak kahzaw hi.
english: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in pai in aw, nang toh kei kikal ah leh ka suante leh na suante kikal ah tangtawn in TOUPA om hen, chi in TOUPA min in i kichiam tuak khinta hi,” achi hi. Huchi in adingh a, apaita a, khua ah Jonathan alutta hi.
english: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘Yahweh is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.
